subject: physics

hotspots.label: Distance Counter
hotspots.description: The full length of the path traveled — a scalar counter that ticks up with every meter and never decreases.
hotspots.positionHint: A floating meter readout above the course, updating as the hiker moves.
hotspots.function: Adds up the total path length traveled in meters.

hotspots.label: Start Point
hotspots.description: The gate where the path begins — distance starts counting from here.
hotspots.positionHint: A start-arch at the left edge of the course.

hotspots.label: Finish Point
hotspots.description: The gate where the path ends. Even if you loop back here, the distance counter keeps its full total.
hotspots.positionHint: A finish-arch on the right edge of the course.
hotspots.function: Marks where the measured leg of the path ends.

hotspots.label: Straight Line (displacement)
hotspots.description: The direct shortcut from start to finish — the displacement, which is usually shorter than the full distance covered.
hotspots.positionHint: A dashed straight arrow from finish to start floating over the winding path.
hotspots.function: Shows the displacement contrast to the measured distance.

visualStyleNotes: Anatomy Atelier bar: warm off-white/paper background (#F7F3EC) with soft radial vignette, no floor grid, no props besides the mat. A flat warm-wooden course with cones and a bridge, a little hiker character, a floating amber distance readout, and a dashed magenta straight shortcut. Saturated color only on the hotspot dots and the dashed arrow. Soft neutral studio light, no bloom, no emissive.
materialNotes: Metallic-roughness PBR, metallic=0 everywhere. Course mat warm-grey wood (roughness ~0.7), cones in accent geometry (soft orange, roughness ~0.6), hiker in warm paper neutral (roughness ~0.85), readout plate warm paper with ink text. No emissive — the live distance number is drawn by the app runtime UI.
assetBrief:
SUBJECT: distance as total path length on a winding course, contrasted with a straight-line displacement shortcut.

GEOMETRY: a flat rectangular course (say 4.0 × 2.4 world units) on the floor at y=0. Start gate at x=-1.6, finish gate at x=+1.6. Between them a S-curved path (a raised ribbon, y≈0.06) with cones on either side. A small hiker token rides the path. A floating meter plate above reads live distance. A dashed straight arrow spans start→finish horizontally at y≈0.5.

INTERACTION: a distance slider drags the hiker along the path ribbon and the counter increments; a layer toggles the shortcut arrow and resets to a straight drag.

LAYERS: (1) path+cones, (2) hiker+readout, (3) straight-line arrow.

NAMED NODES: CourseMat, StartGate, FinishGate, PathRibbon, Hiker, MeterPlate, ShortcutArrow. Budget 7-11k triangles, smooth topology.
